title: Ancillary Balances Held Back from Resident Funds Withdrawals
content:
For a withdrawal of the spare amount from a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, **the ancillary bills kept** are held back from the spare amount. They follow the resident's open account under Ancillary and Optional Services Billing and the most recent per-bill authorization naming an ancillary charge (of two signed at the same moment, the one recorded first):

| Records | Ancillary bills kept |
|---|---|
| that authorization awaits its transfer (no transfer from the account names its charge yet) and authorizes less than its charge's open balance | the ancillary account's open balance less the part of that charge the authorization leaves out, because the representative pays that part another way |
| the ancillary account otherwise carries an open balance | that open balance |
| otherwise | nothing |

The part of the charge the authorization leaves out is the charge's open balance (the charge less the payments and credits naming it) less the amount authorized.

## Hypothetical illustration

Ancillary account open balance $312.60; the most recent per-bill authorization names a charge with an open balance of $180.00.

| Authorization | Transfer naming the charge | Ancillary bills kept |
|---|---|---|
| $117.40 | none yet | $312.60 less $62.60: $250.00 |
| $117.40 | already made | $312.60 |
| $180.00 | none yet | $312.60 |
| any; ancillary account balance $0.00 | — | nothing |
